messages.author: 9f17b5bc4abc61f5
messages.subject: Munging summary statistics from ENIGMA
parts:
Good evening,

How do you go about munging the summary statistics from ENIGMA for brain volumes? I am using the hippocampal volume summary statistics and when I attempt to munge the file, the output reports 9707621 out of 9707621 rows were removed because the rs-ids for these rows were not present in the reference file. The file was unable to be munged, therefore couldn't provide a HV.sumstats.gz.

Any suggestions would be greatly appreciated.

Much thanks,
Moreh Jackson

messages.subject: Re: Munging summary statistics from ENIGMA
parts:
Hi Moreh,

the RS number column should have one of : ""SNP","SNPID","RSID","RS_NUMBER","RS_NUMBERS", "MARKERNAME", "ID" as header

and the chr:BP column should not have one of these as name. 

So if you rename the column that should dop the trick.

Best,
Michel

messages.subject: Re: Munging summary statistics from ENIGMA
parts:
Hi Moreh, 

Thanks for sending along! I took a look and I think their were a couple small issues that had to with read.delim not reading in the file right, missing N as a column name, and missing a ' in the code you used in the column names code. Try running the code below and running again and that should do the trick. 

HV_data<- read.table("CHARGE-ENIGMA-HV-METAANALYSIS-201311141.TBL.FINAL",header=TRUE)
colnames(HV_data)<- c('CHR:BP', 'A1', 'A2', 'Freq1', 'FreqSE', 'MinFreq', 'MaxFreq', 'Weight', 'Zscore', 'Pvalue', 'Direction', 'HetISq', 'HetChiSq', 'HetDf', 'HetPval','N', 'RSID')

Best, 
  Andrew
